title: Italian Sausage Hangover Breakfast
description: A hearty breakfast dish to combat morning after symptoms, combining Italian sausages with a luscious twist.

ingredients.name: Italian sausages
ingredients.notes: Choose sweet or hot Italian sausages

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Large eggs for a filling breakfast

instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Cook the Italian sausages until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the sausages from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the minced garlic and chopped onions to the skillet and cook until softened.
5. Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
6. Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
7. Pour the eggs over the mushrooms in the skillet and scramble them until cooked through.
8. Return the cooked sausages to the skillet and stir to combine with the eggs and mushrooms.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Serve the sausage and egg mixture over Italian bread.
